excluded_actions: Do not infer additional creative metadata
Do not treat provider-limited weekly temporality as complete

recommendations.action: Run a controlled budget experiment among matched ads with sufficient sample.
recommendations.expected_direction: increase A/B rate or reduce cost per A/B
recommendations.hypothesis: A bounded redistribution inside commercial matched ads may improve A/B rate without worsening cost per A/B.
recommendations.population: commercial matched ad_id_norm rows with at least 20 leads and 5 A/B leads
recommendations.primary_metric: A/B rate in commercial matched universe
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: stop if sample falls below threshold or spend coverage changes
recommendations.success_criterion: PASS if A/B rate increases versus control while cost_per_ab_commercial_matched is stable or lower over two comparable weeks.

recommendations.action: Classify every lead_only and spend_only ad_id_norm before using economic metrics for budget decisions.
recommendations.closure_criterion: all current lead_only and spend_only rows have a declared reason code
recommendations.dependency: authorized Meta lead and spend sources
recommendations.verifiable_result: coverage register classifies each asymmetry without overwriting coverage state

recommendations.action: Run a form or qualification test focused on tiene_billetes/en_proceso share.
recommendations.guardrail: lead volume and Tier A count do not collapse
recommendations.hypothesis: A form or qualification-question test can increase qualified share without requiring revenue evidence.
recommendations.population: Meta Lead Ads forms with FARO coverage
recommendations.primary_metric: share of A/B leads and ticket_status tiene_billetes/en_proceso
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: stop if unmapped responses appear or weekly comparability remains partial
recommendations.success_criterion: PASS if qualified-share lift is observed with stable lead volume and no increase in unmapped responses.
recommendations.validation_window: one complete month or two comparable complete weeks

recommendations.hypothesis: Revenue/CRM outcomes may change FARO-only prioritization.
recommendations.promotion_condition: promote only when future evidence is authorized and reconciled
recommendations.support: FARO and ticket_status show quality strata but not commercial value.
